aboutText: JR Dixon Electrical is a Truganina-based electrical specialist offering a professional, solution-focused approach to bring ideas to life. Our team works across residential, commercial, and industrial projects, completing hundreds of jobs throughout Melbourne and Geelong. We pride ourselves on quality workmanship and reliable service that Truganina locals can count on.
servicesText: From Truganina homes to Melbourne commercial sites, we deliver safe, compliant electrical work. Our licensed team handles projects of all sizes across residential, commercial, and industrial settings.

services.title: Residential Electrical
services.desc: Complete home electrical services for Truganina residents including wiring, rewiring, and safety checks for houses of all sizes.

services.title: Commercial Electrical
services.desc: Office fit-outs, retail electrical systems, and commercial switchboard upgrades for businesses across Melbourne's west.

services.title: Industrial Electrical
services.desc: Heavy-duty electrical installations and maintenance for factories, warehouses, and industrial facilities in Truganina and surrounds.

services.title: Switchboard Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrade outdated switchboards to meet current Australian safety standards, protecting your home or business from electrical hazards.

services.title: Lighting Installation
services.desc: Interior and exterior lighting solutions including energy-efficient LED upgrades for homes, shops, and commercial spaces.

services.title: Electrical Maintenance
services.desc: Scheduled maintenance and emergency repairs to keep your electrical systems running safely and efficiently year-round.
